scope: All docs/hypotheses Markdown artifacts and directly associated plan-based protocols, qualification and tooling studies. Not a registry of every plan or audit.

rules.unit: One experimental question/protocol sequence per record; protocol and results are artifacts of that record. Separate confirmation/revised tests keep distinct IDs.
rules.questions: Short routing labels; native protocols own hypotheses, thresholds and exact questions.
rules.review_status: result_reviewed means selected result/decision prose was read, not independent execution or full raw-data verification. independently_reproduced requires a separately evidenced reproduction. not_reviewed forbids an inferred verdict.
rules.outcomes: Native result or decision records own verdicts. outcome_source identifies the classification source; synthesis and corrections belong to the linked wiki.
rules.cost: No comparable effort measures extracted. Unknown is not zero. Protocol time caps are not actual elapsed effort.
rules.dispositions: Historical experiment-scoped dispositions, not current assignments. Current plan alone owns priorities.
rules.ontology: The explicit legacy_unversioned_record_ids inventory preserves historical records without speculative backfill. Every record outside that closed inventory must declare the required ontology contract version in its native protocol. Native results and run metadata own observed values and provenance. Historical records are not classified from filenames; absent ontology metadata means unclassified, not a negative scientific result. Structural validation does not certify scientific adequacy.

experiments.question: Does the idiosyncratic fraction measure coordination, or only differentiation?
experiments.disposition: G1 necessity passes (coordinated 0.934, uniform 0.000) but G2 sufficiency fails with margin -0.014 against a required +0.20: a matched independent random population scores HIGHER (0.948) than the coordinated one. The statistic measures differentiation, not coordination, so an instrument using it would report structure in a random population, which clause 2 forbids. Persistence fails the same test (0.921 vs 0.877). Predicted in advance against my own proposed statistic. Secondary and more important: random_attempt reaches 0.375 need satisfaction against derived_phase 0.438, so C2-001 - which headlined derived against level_only at 0.000 - was missing a random control and its effect is 17% relative rather than total. Same defect class as C1-001 best-constant control, twice in one session. C2 narrowed accordingly. The rival source is now named and a matched-randomness control should be standing rather than per-experiment.

experiments.question: Does the frozen detector, unchanged, separate a differentiated population from an active undifferentiated one on a family it was not built for?
experiments.disposition: Clause 4 satisfied by construction: the detector was authored against a divisible commons and run unchanged on an indivisible slot with a phase-based mechanism and a collision failure mode. It separated a differentiated population (persistence 0.921) from an active undifferentiated one (0.698) in the predicted direction. But the frozen prediction said low under the negative arm and 0.698 is not low - Q1-003's negative scored 0.062 - so the flagged risk partly materialised and the statistic is substantially measuring temporal extent rather than differentiation. Protocol defect recorded rather than exploited: it froze a direction but no numeric threshold, so the 0.1 gap cutoff is post-hoc and is not treated as a passed gate. Instrument NOT declared qualified outright; status is directional transfer on a statistic partly measuring the wrong thing. The variance-fraction inversion from Q1-003 replicates exactly on this second family (constant 1.000 vs derived 0.067), which strengthens that finding considerably.

experiments.question: How load-bearing is the derivation rule that turns a subunit's own goal into a phase?
experiments.disposition: Landed in the frozen partial band (44.4% within 90% of authored), and reporting the distribution rather than rounding it produced the actual result: neither plateau nor ridge, but exact bimodality. The offset b does nothing (a constant before a modulo rotates all phases uniformly). Performance is a function of gcd(a, P) alone with no residual variation inside a class - 0.438 for coprime, 0.112 at gcd 2, 0.013 at gcd 5, 0.000 at gcd 10, matching 10/5/2/1 available phases. Unifies with C2-001: the rule affects performance only through how many of the environment's distinct values it preserves. Rule discovery is therefore a condition to satisfy, not a search problem. Partly clears the standing worry that my authored choices carry the mechanisms: a=1 is joint best tied with 19 other coprime members, so it was in the optimal class by construction rather than by judgement, though I could have violated the condition by picking a=2. Untested: a prime period, where the bimodality should vanish.

experiments.question: Can the distinguishing information that breaks symmetry come from the environment's own heterogeneity rather than from a designer assigning labels?
experiments.disposition: All three gates pass: precondition P0 (authored beats level-only 8/8, explicitly not a finding since it re-derives TDMA), G1 (derived beats level-only 8/8 at widest spread), G2 (derived monotonic in need spread). Mechanism confirmed rather than assumed: performance tracks the number of distinct phases the environment supplies, rising 1.0 to 6.6 as spread widens, and at zero spread every subunit derives the same phase, collides forever and scores exactly 0.000 as predicted. Real limit recorded: the environment supplied the values but the derivation rule is authored, so the claim is that environmental heterogeneity can substitute for designer-assigned identity GIVEN a rule, not that labels emerge. Fourth consecutive experiment where an authored choice of mine carried the mechanism. Does not change C1's status; C2 was admitted as a separate conjecture.

experiments.question: Does a shared-scalar coordination signal transfer from a divisible renewable resource to an indivisible contended slot?
experiments.disposition: The specimen failed its own pre-declared validity gate across three attempts (0 wins of 8 in every configuration), so the detector was never run, never read and never modified, and clause 4 of the completion condition remains unmet. Stopped at the declared retune budget rather than at the point of running out of ideas. The failure is structural and is the finding: a scalar threshold read identically by every subunit can only gate them together, never stagger them, so it coordinates a divisible renewable stock and cannot allocate an indivisible slot - it is common-mode by construction. Cognitive glue as implemented is a price mechanism and price mechanisms need a divisible good, so C1-001 now looks closer to a rediscovery of why adaptive prices beat fixed ones on a commons than to evidence of a general principle. C1 stays supported-on-one-family and this failure is recorded against it. Extending to symmetry-breaking primitives that carry phase or identity is a separate conjecture with its own refuter, not a rescue of C1.

experiments.question: Can a candidate family with a latent shared regressor separate a shared quantity that gates decisions from one that only constrains outcomes?
experiments.disposition: Persistence distinguishes in the predicted direction (live 0.827 vs none 0.062), closing the structural gap Q1-002 named. Does NOT qualify the instrument: clause 4 of the charter completion condition fails because the family, its estimator and its statistics were authored while holding the specimen's ground truth - the same defect P15 recorded, and worse to repeat knowingly. Development case, not qualification. The naive adequacy statistic (shared-variance fraction) is a trap: it distinguishes in the WRONG direction, scoring the collapsed system 1.000 against the coordinated 0.586, because after collapse every subunit draws zero and residuals become identical - uniformity read as coordination. Caught only because the protocol froze both statistics and their predicted directions before implementation.

experiments.question: Is Q1-001's null caused by the authored observation contract, or by the candidate family?
experiments.disposition: None of three observation contracts distinguishes the coordinated from the uncoordinated run at the disposition level. Rules out the cheap explanation for Q1-001: the coupling is not hidden by packaging, it is unrepresentable in repeated_entity_dynamics, which fits each entity under a shared local law. Contract B (attempted, served) was predicted most likely to succeed and was worst - it made the series less affine and the instrument abstained on both, showing legibility to an analyst and representability in a candidate family are different properties. Consequence: a shared packaging contract is worth building and will not buy coordination detection; those are two separate units of work.

experiments.question: Can the analytic instrument recover an authored coordination it was not told about, and not report it where it is absent?
experiments.disposition: Same disposition for a coordinated and an uncoordinated run of the same system: shared_local_affine, candidate, passive_sufficient true on both. Worse than a tie - the instrument affirms passive sufficiency on a system whose behaviour is mediated by a shared quantity outside every entity. Clause 1 of the charter completion condition fails, so no construction claim in this programme is verified. Two positives: the proposal path accepted a fifth system it was not written for, confirming the case-specificity is in the packer not the proposer, and the vague open-endedness frontier is replaced by a specific gap - repeated_entity_dynamics has no candidate expressing dependence on an exogenous shared quantity.

experiments.question: Does a shared scarcity signal have to track scarcity, or does the best fixed threshold coordinate as well?
experiments.disposition: All three frozen gates passed (G1 8/8, G2 8/8, G3 monotonic), and the conclusion survives a stronger control than the frozen one: adaptive 1.000 vs best fixed threshold 0.500. But the protocol's stated justification for its negative control is measured false - the frozen level (live time-average, ~0.51) sits below the 0.60-0.85 band where any constant works, so the recorded 0.000-to-1.000 effect size overstates. Restated effect: tracking roughly doubles satisfaction over the best constant. Constructive, authored, white-box, one family; not a discovery and not a claim about composition in general.

experiments.question: Can a modest type-directed proposal layer produce decision-relevant relational candidates or honest abstention across opaque archived systems without task labels?
experiments.disposition: Seam passes: both held cases (P13, P14) and, after correcting a P12 evaluator disposition-rule error, both development cases (P10, P12) matched native dispositions with all leakage/lineage/package checks passing. Capability claim relational_proposal_and_abstention is NOT established: its frozen operating condition 'no case-specific code paths' was violated on both sides of the freeze (four hand-written per-case proposers behind a dispatch, fed by four hand-written per-case packers that assign the dispatch key), and cross-case generality is measured at zero (12/12 refusals, 2026-09-04 probe). The held-system decision gate is therefore not cleanly earned; no discovery, generalization, or competence claim.
